natural.name: shipping_mode_speed
natural.description: Ordinal shipping service level chosen for the order (0 = same day, 3 = standard slow service).

natural.name: scheduled_ship_days
natural.description: Number of days the carrier promised for delivery when the order was placed.

natural.name: order_processing_time
natural.description: Days between the order being placed and dispatched (internal handling time before the carrier takes over).

natural.name: geographic_distance
natural.description: Great-circle distance from the customer location to the network's mean hub location, in km (a distance-to-serve proxy).

natural.name: order_item_count
natural.description: Number of distinct line items in the order.

natural.name: total_quantity
natural.description: Total units of product across all line items of the order.

natural.name: total_sales
natural.description: Total sales value of the order in dollars.

natural.name: avg_discount_rate
natural.description: Average discount rate applied across the order's line items.

natural.name: daily_order_volume
natural.description: Number of orders the retailer received on the same calendar day (fulfilment workload proxy).

natural.name: region_weekly_orders
natural.description: Number of orders from the same destination region in the same week (regional demand proxy).

natural.name: delivery_delay
natural.description: Actual delivery days minus promised delivery days; positive means the order arrived late (outcome).
